reuse.why: Adds the rule inside the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount and reuses its existing account lookup rather than adding a new query or helper.

duplication.why: The account lookup is moved, not copied, so the row is fetched once and the closed check exists once.

placement.why: The check sits in linkBankSyncAccount, the single server function every provider-specific link handler delegates to, before any write or sync.

scope.why: Only the shared link function and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Small hoist of the existing lookup with an early guard; easy to read and covers all providers.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount, used by all provider link handlers (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu, Enable Banking, Fintegra)
